5121.o: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.

5123.o: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5124.o: Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.

5126.o: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.$B

5127.o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.$B$BYou must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.$B$BReturn both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.

5128.o: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.

5141.o: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Peter Galen in Azshara.$B$BCompleting this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.$B$BThe completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5143.o: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Caryssia Moonhunter in Feralas.$B$BCompleting this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.$B$BThe completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5144.o: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Sarah Tanner in Searing Gorge.$B$BCompleting this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.$B$BThe completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5145.o: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Thorkaf Dragoneye in the Badlands.$B$BCompleting this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.$B$BThe completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5146.o: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Brumn Winterhoof in the Arathi Mountains.$B$BCompleting this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.$B$BThe completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5147.o: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

5148.o: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Se’Jib in Stranglethorn Vale.$B$BCompleting this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.$B$BThe completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5151.o: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.

5152.o: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.

5153.o: Bring Joseph’s Wedding Ring to Chromie.

5154.o: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.

5155.o: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5156.o: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.

5157.o: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5158.o: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

5159.o: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5160.o: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee’s scale.

5161.o: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.

5162.o: Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.

5163.o: Take Umi’s Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it:$B$BLegacki in Everlook (Winterspring)$BSprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris)$BQuixxil in Marshal’s Refuge (Un’Goro Crater)$B$BWhen you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.

5164.o: Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.$B

5165.o: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

5166.o: To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the ’Sculptor’:$B$B1 Chromatic Carapace.$B$B10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.$B$B10 Blood of Heroes.$B$B10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings.

5167.o: To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the ’Sculptor’:$B$B1 Chromatic Carapace.$B$B10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.$B$B10 Blood of Heroes.$B$B5 Skin of Shadow.

5168.o: Bring Davil’s Libram and Redpath’s Shield to Carlin Redpath.

5181.o: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light’s Hope Chapel.

5201.o: Slay 5 Winterfall Shamans and 5 Winterfall Ursas.

5202.o: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

5203.o: Escort Arko’narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what’s happened to her friends.

5204.o: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

5206.o: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

5210.o: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

5211.o: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.

5212.o: Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

5213.o: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.$B

5214.o: Find Fras Siabi’s smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Siabi’s Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.$B

5215.o: Speak with High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

5216.o: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there.  It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5217.o: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5219.o: Go to Dalson’s Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Dalson’s Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5220.o: Bring the Filled Dalson’s Tears Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5222.o: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5223.o: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5225.o: Go to Gahrron’s Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Gahrron’s Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5226.o: Bring the Filled Gahrron’s Withering Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5228.o: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5229.o: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there.  It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5230.o: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5231.o: Go to Dalson’s Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Dalson’s Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5232.o: Bring the Filled Dalson’s Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5233.o: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5234.o: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5235.o: Go to Gahrron’s Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Gahrron’s Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5236.o: Bring the Filled Gahrron’s Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5242.o: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel’dan’s Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5243.o: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.

5244.o: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.

5245.o: Use Jaron’s Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments. Bring them to Aurora Skycaller in Eastern Plaguelands.

5246.o: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

5247.o: Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

5248.o: Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel’Theril in Winterspring and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you.

5249.o: Find Starfall Village in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

5250.o: Find Starfall in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

5251.o: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

5252.o: Speak with Wynd Nightchaser in Starfall Village, and ask about the proper place for the Crystal of Zin-Malor.

5253.o: Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

5262.o: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.

5263.o: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.$B

5264.o: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.

5265.o: Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.

5281.o: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

5282.o: Use Egan’s Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!$B$BFree 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

5283.o: To become an Armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Grumnus: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

5284.o: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Ironus: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.$B

5301.o: To become an armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Okothos: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

5302.o: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Borgosh: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.$B

5305.o: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith’s Apron and return to Lilith.$B

5306.o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh’gajin. Recover Vosh’gajin’s Snakestone and return to Kilram.

5307.o: Find the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and destroy him. Recover the Insignia of the Black Guard and return to Seril Scourgebane.

5321.o: Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Liladris Moonriver at Maestra’s Post in Ashenvale.

5341.o: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

5342.o: Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov.$B$BBe warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.

5343.o: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.

5344.o: Travel to the Bulwark - Horde territory - and assassinate Alexi Barov. Take his head and return to Weldon Barov.$B$BBe warned, Alexi will probably be well protected by Horde filth.

5361.o: Deliver Cliffwatcher Longhorn Report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.
